text:
maria (eng-platform): Following the KV eviction postmortem, we need to lock owners + timelines for remediation and the tests it spawns. Proposal: regression for KV eviction patterns, expand promptset for cache-cold/long-tail cases, new load test scenario to ramp GC/cache pressure, and a chaos drill on staging to simulate partial node loss. Volunteers?

jamal (eng-sre): +1 I can own the KV regression tests. Will add pytest harness + a few deterministic kv-eviction cases. Target: 2026-04-10.

alex (eng-ml): I can take the promptset expansion. Will add ~200 targeted examples for prefix/cache miss patterns and boundary token sizes. ETA 2026-04-05.

emily (eng-ml): For load tests I propose a `ramp_to_90pct` scenario (sustained tokens/sec with synthetic KV churn). I'll write the Locust script and a brief doc. ETA 2026-04-12.

ryan (eng-oncall): I can schedule the chaos drill for 2026-04-15. I'll coordinate oncall coverage + runbook updates. Recommend we freeze canary deploys that day.

maria (eng-platform): Thanks — I'll be tracking this in the postmortem followup. I'll create an epic and break out tasks; weekly check-ins until all items are closed. Please add PR links to the ticket.

kayla (devex): I'll wire these into the eval dashboard: add regression metrics and alert thresholds. Alex I need sample outputs by 2026-04-06 so we can craft regression assertions.

ops-bot: Reminder: create epic INF-1234 and link tasks. React with :white_check_mark: when linked.

jamal (eng-sre): Draft branch created: `sre/kv-regress-eviction`. PR coming, tests currently flaky under parallel CI runs, debugging now.

jamal (eng-sre): Quick CI snippet I used to reproduce locally:

```yaml
jobs:
  kv_regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: pytest tests/kv_eviction.py::test_prefix_eviction -k slow -q
```

alex (eng-ml): Uploaded first 50 prompt examples to GDrive, link in INF-1234. Will iterate based on Kayla's assertions.

emily (eng-ml): Locust script pushed to `infra/load-tests/kv_thrash.py`. Basic ramp profile: 0->500 users in 10m, hold 15m, spike random node kills. Needs coordination with Ryan for the spike window.

ryan (eng-oncall): Noted. I'll reserve 2026-04-15 14:00-16:00 UTC for the chaos window and add a muted alert policy for the run.

maria (eng-platform): Action items summary (I'll paste into the postmortem doc):
- KV regression tests -> jamal -> 2026-04-10
- Promptset expansion -> alex -> 2026-04-05
- Load test scenario -> emily -> 2026-04-12
- Chaos drill scheduling + runbook -> ryan -> 2026-04-15
- Eval/dashboard integration -> kayla -> 2026-04-06

maria (eng-platform): Please add status updates to INF-1234. We'll review at the weekly platform sync on Mondays.

jamal (eng-sre): PR: https://rwd.repo/pr/4521 - added deterministic eviction case + initial CI job. Marking WIP until CI flakes fixed. :construction: 

alex (eng-ml): Added sample output file to the ticket, named `promptset-kv-cold-v1.jsonl`. Kayla ping if format needs tweaks.

kayla (devex): Got it. Format looks good; will start writing regression assertions tomorrow.

emily (eng-ml): One risk note: the load test currently reproduces a small variance in latency but not the full KV thrash observed in prod. Might need to inject synthetic background traffic (embedding/async requests). Flagging for planning.

maria (eng-platform): Good catch. Emily, please add an item to the load-test task to model background embedding churn.

ops-bot: INF-1234 created by maria. Link: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234 :white_check_mark: 

maria (eng-platform): Thanks — marking this thread as the canonical followup. We'll use INF-1234 updates for status; ping me if timelines slip.

ryan (eng-oncall): One small ask — can we run the chaos drill in a lower-impact region first? Suggest staging-us-west-2 -> staging-eu after successful run.

emily (eng-ml): Agree, us-west-2 first makes sense. I'll coordinate with infra.

jamal (eng-sre): For visibility, I'll add a short log snippet to the ticket showing eviction counts at time of incident.

maria (eng-platform): Perfect. Thanks everyone. :pray:
